GroupSynchronizer - Class in de.l9g.scm.oauth2.plugin
Synchronizes the groups of the group claim with the scm group database on every login: groups which do not exist yet are created with the user as member the user is added as member to existing groups from the claim the user is removed from groups which were synchronized on a previous login, but are no longer part of the claim groups are never deleted, even if they become empty Only groups which were previously synchronized for this user are touched on removal, so manually maintained memberships in other groups are preserved.
GroupSynchronizer(GroupManager, AdministrationContext) - Constructor for class de.l9g.scm.oauth2.plugin.GroupSynchronizer
